ops.title: PR 699: bound rmtree directory enumeration within each slice
ops.description: Owner: yasyf, PR #699 implementation lane. Evidence: internal/cleanup/rmtree/walk.go:367-391 enumerates through EOF without checking tokens or deadline, and queues every name; Step waits for this task at walk.go:142. With one worker, even Step(1, 50ms, 1) must enumerate an entire wide directory before its first unlink; with multiple workers enumeration continues after the slice expires. This defeats bounded slices, allocates O(directory width) queued tasks, and delays command handling at daemon/engine.go:697 and :756. Next step: turn listing into bounded continuation tasks, preserve pass state until EOF, and schedule batch removals before refilling the queue.

ops.text: Wide-directory listing retains a bounded queue independent of directory width.
After progress, expiry yields after admitted bounded operations without draining the directory to EOF.
CI verifies exact removal counts and directory-pass progress semantics with one and sixteen workers; no tests run on the overloaded host.
